verdict.rationale: Supabase Realtime explicitly supports Postgres Changes to listen to database changes live, plus Broadcast/Presence for pushing updates to clients, directly enabling UI updates without polling; corroborated by GitHub feature list citing 'Realtime subscriptions' and a founder's design note about WAL-based realtime being more scalable than triggers. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark or third-party confirmation of subscription reliability at scale.
